paper_style.palette_strategy: 方法对比使用 categorical blue/purple/orange/green/red，PIP/effect matrix 使用 sequential 色带，λ/E 曲线使用 sample-size 颜色，概念图使用 pastel semantic blocks；表格以黑白 booktabs 与粗体表达重点。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: 所有 Figure 的主要绘图区是 PDF 内嵌 RGB raster PNG XObject（复合图含多个组件）；caption、正文、公式、Algorithm 和 Table 为 PDF text/line objects。
paper_style.style_consistency: 正文/附录延续双栏、booktabs、caption 下置与黑白表格风格；图内 sans-serif raster 字号和颜色角色按图族局部一致，但跨图颜色语义会切换。

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1. Bayesian Hypergraph Pathway Inference Workflow. (a) Input data consist of patient covariates and multiple disease outcomes. (b) A latent disease hypergraph models higher-order structure via hyperedges, allowing diseases to participate in multiple pathways with uncertain existence and membership. (c) Risk factors act on hyperedges to induce structured effects across diseases, yielding disentangled attribution. Shaded regions denote posterior uncertainty. Bottom panels: Structured Variational Inference (left) preserves logical dependencies to learn the latent topology including hyperedge existence and membership (middle), while a repulsion prior (right) discourages redundant pathways to ensure a parsimonious and interpretable latent structure.

color.semantic_mapping: 模块位置和 pastel pathway 颜色区分数据、latent topology、effect propagation 与 posterior/update 约束；不确定性用阴影与椭圆冗余表示。

figures.evidence_relation: Introduction 的 latent risk-factor-modulated pathways → Section 3 的 hypergraph/effect equations → Figure 1 workflow → Figures 3–4 的 PIP topology 与 pathway cases。
design_strengths: 三段主链与下排 inference constraint/regularizer 分解在同一画布上闭合。
直接标签、箭头、位置和颜色形成颜色之外的冗余语法；公开 workflow asset 可复核主几何。

caption.text: Figure 2. Predictive stability via structured information sharing. Distribution of per-disease ∆AUC scores (relative to tuned Logistic Regression) stratified by disease prevalence. While baselines like LGBM and Classifier Chains exhibit high variance and instability for rare diseases, BHPI maintains robust performance by borrowing strength across shared latent pathways.

(Right) Summary of the thresholded structure (PIP(ze = 1) > 0.5), showing compact pathway sizes, limited pathway participation per disease and risk factor, and overall structural parsimony.

figures.label: Figure 4

caption.text: Figure 4. Global visualization of the learned risk-factor–to-disease pathway structure (hyperedges with PIP(ze = 1) > 0.5) (Left). Risk factors (top) connect to latent pathways (middle), which in turn connect to diseases (bottom). Edge widths correspond to PIPs, illustrating uncertainty, overlap, and modular risk propagation. Node annotations report the number of incident pathways. Pathway-level illustration (Right). Divergent risk pathways for smoking (top) and convergent disease pathways involving Dementia (bottom).

figures.label: Figure 5

caption.text: Figure 5. Plate diagram of the BHPI generative model. The generative DAG is: z_e → m_{v,e} ; H_{v,e} = z_e m_{v,e} ; {z_e , H} → γ_{j,e} → μ_{j,e} ; β_{j,v} = d_v^{-1} ∑_e H_{v,e} μ_{j,e} ; y_{i,v} ∼ Bernoulli(σ(α_v + x_i^T β_v)).

color.semantic_mapping: 四个浅色分区区分 hypergraph structure、predictor–hyperedge effects、coefficients 和 observed data；虚线 plate 与箭头提供颜色之外的结构编码。

figures.data_and_statistics: 生成模型 plate diagram，不包含样本值；标注 V、P×E、P×V、N×V、N 等维度以及 z_e→m→H→γ/μ→β→y 的方程关系。
figures.evidence_relation: Section 3 latent hypergraph/observation model → Figure 5 generative DAG → Appendix A Eq. (3)–(15) 与 Algorithm 1 CAVI updates。

分区色彩在灰度下主要是弱装饰，依赖虚线边界和标题。
figures.reusable_pattern: 按 latent structure/effect/coefficient/observed 四层分区，在 caption 中写最短 DAG，并显式标出 conditional-zero constraint。

caption.text: Table 1. Predictive performance on simulated data. Mean (standard deviation) AUC on held-out test sets (× 100). BHPI achieves competitive disease risk prediction while simultaneously inferring latent disease pathways.

caption.text: Table 2. Recovery of latent risk structure on simulated data (N = 2000). Metrics include agreement between true and inferred disease-level risk contributions β, AUC for recovering hypergraph structure H, and risk-factor-hyperedge associations γ (× 100).

tables.label: Table 3

caption.text: Table 3. Role of the repulsion prior in hypergraph identifiability (N = 2000). Predictive performance remains stable, while repulsion reduces redundancy and improves stability of inferred hyperedges, as measured by Jaccard similarity (Jacc.), overlap coefficients (Ov.) across replicates, effective hyperedge (Eff.#/RF) per risk factor (RF), and hyperedge overlap per RF (Ov./RF).

tables.evidence_relation: Figure 2 disease-level stability → calibration table → Table 5/6 rare-disease and structural comparison。
design_strengths: 单栏表快速展示 ECE/Brier，caption 给出 BHPI 的 calibration headline。
黑白粗体不依赖色彩。
design_weaknesses: caption 突出 BHPI，但 Logistic 的 ECE 更低且 Brier 为 tie。
per-disease weighting、aggregation 和 uncertainty 缺失。
tables.reusable_pattern: 主表保留少量 calibration metrics，附录解释分母、weighting 和 split variability。

tables.label: Table 5

caption.text: Table 5. Mean ∆AUC (×100) versus per-disease Logistic on UKB, with paired Wilcoxon p-values, stratified by disease prevalence. Only BHPI consistently outperforms Logistic. Bold indicates entries with p < 0.05.

tables.uncertainty: 单元为 mean ΔAUC ×100，括号为 paired Wilcoxon p-value；未提供 effect uncertainty 或 multiple-comparison correction。
tables.evidence_relation: UKB rare-disease question → structured-baseline contrast → Figures 3–4 mechanism 与 Table 6 mask test；是主文最直接的 prevalence-specific quantitative object。
design_strengths: prevalence 分层避免总体均值掩盖 long-tail behavior。
ΔAUC、paired p-value 和高亮规则在一张表内可扫描。
design_weaknesses: 每组只有 aggregate，缺 group n、paired unit、correction 和 disease-level distribution。
baseline tuning 对称性及 p-value interpretation 需要正文。
tables.reusable_pattern: 用 prevalence-stratified effect + paired test 取代单一总体均值，并报告 group n、pairing 和 correction policy。

tables.label: Table 6

caption.text: Table 6. PIP-stratified mean AUC (×100) on UKB (66 diseases) and simulation. High-PIP edges retain essentially all predictive signal; low-PIP edges are close to chance.

tables.uncertainty: mean AUC ×100；未给 SD/区间、mask sample count 或独立重训 variation。
tables.data_and_statistics: Full 68.9/69.7/71.6/75.7；High-PIP only 68.7/69.6/71.6/75.6；Random subset 60.2/61.3/62.7/65.7；Low-PIP only 58.6/55.0/57.4/51.2，前三列为 UKB prevalence groups，SIMU 为 simulation。
tables.evidence_relation: Figure 3 PIP structure → high/low/random mask → Figure 4 pathway interpretation；是 structure-to-signal mechanism test，不是独立训练的 causal ablation。
design_strengths: 四种 mask/configuration 直接对照 PIP ranking 与 predictive signal。
按 prevalence 展开，能观察 rare/common 差异。
design_weaknesses: masking 复用 full-model 学到的结构，存在 selection leakage 可能。
random subset size、threshold 和独立重训规则未在 caption 明示。
tables.reusable_pattern: 用 high/low/random mask 检验 learned uncertainty 与 signal 的关系，并预先固定 threshold、subset size 和 retraining。

tables.label: Table 7

caption.text: Table 7. Role of the repulsion prior in hypergraph identifiability (N = 2000 and 5000). Predictive performance remains stable, while repulsion reduces redundancy and improves stability of inferred hyperedges, as measured by Jaccard similarity (Jacc.), overlap coefficients (Ov.) across replicates, effective hyperedge (Eff.#/RF) per risk factor (RF), and hyperedge overlap per RF (Ov./RF).

tables.uncertainty: N=2000/5000 的 mean summaries；结构 overlap 跨 replicates 计算，但未显示 SD。
tables.evidence_relation: Table 3 N=2000 ablation → Table 7 sample-size extension → Figures 8–10 continuous sensitivity。
design_strengths: 一个 grouped table 暴露 sample size 与 λ 的交互并保留完整 structure metrics。
N 分组比拆成多表更节省版面。
design_weaknesses: 11 列字号偏小，且 AUC/overlap/effective count 的方向不同。
粗体规则和 run-level uncertainty 不充分。
tables.reusable_pattern: 用 grouped columns 扩展 component ablation 的规模维度，并按 metric direction 加表注。

tables.label: Table 8

caption.text: Table 8. Structural-PIP calibration: CAVI vs full Gibbs MCMC sampler (mean ± s.d. across 50 replicates). ECE is the per-variable expected calibration error of the PIPs.

tables.uncertainty: MCMC/CAVI mean ± s.d. across 50 replicates；ECE 为 per-variable expected calibration error。
tables.evidence_relation: Structured VI calibration claim → CAVI/full Gibbs check → Appendix B.5 initialization/label-symmetry limit；是经验比较而非 posterior guarantee。
design_strengths: H overlap、三种 PIP ECE 和 predictive AUC 的 calibration 面板集中。
mean±s.d. 与 50 replicates 让 variation 可见。
design_weaknesses: 没有 difference test、decision threshold、ECE binning 或 convergence evidence。
MCMC reference 的 compute budget 未写入表注。
tables.reusable_pattern: 近似 inference 论文同时给 structural calibration、predictive output 和 reference sampler，并公开 ECE 定义/预算。

tables.label: Table 9

caption.text: Table 9. UK Biobank dataset characteristics. The cohort exhibits high-dimensional predictors, substantial class imbalance, and a mix of common and rare disease outcomes.

tables.uncertainty: Cohort descriptive statistics；不是跨 split uncertainty。
tables.data_and_statistics: Participants N=277,291；risk factors P=71；disease outcomes V=66；prevalence median=1.8%、range=1.0–21.8%；average diseases/patient=4.2；observation window=19 years。
tables.evidence_relation: Section 5.5 UKB setup → cohort scale/prevalence anchor → Figure 2、Tables 4–6、Figure 11 的 rare-disease evidence。
design_strengths: 两列压缩 N/P/V、prevalence、sparsity 和 observation window，提供所有结果的 denominator anchor。
italic group labels 给窄表加入层级。
design_weaknesses: 没有 QC exclusion、outcome coding、missingness 或 split counts。
Data Sparsity 分组定义和组标签计数规则仍需正文。
tables.reusable_pattern: 按 cohort scale→prevalence→sparsity 分组，并补 exclusions、missingness 和 split unit。

tables.label: Table 10

caption.text: Table 10. Wall-clock runtimes for simulated data and UK Biobank application (N ≈ 277, 291; V = 66). Synthetic tests were conducted on a single-core Intel Xeon 6342 (4 GB RAM); UK Biobank results utilized 4 cores and 60 GB RAM. BHPI maintains inference latency on par with Logistic Regression (< 0.1 ms) while providing structured latent discovery.

tables.uncertainty: 单硬件 point measurements，无 SD、重复测量或跨硬件范围；BHPI slash-separated E values 是配置并列而非误差。
tables.data_and_statistics: Simulation runtime sec（N=2000/N=5000）：Logistic 0.12/0.23、LightGBM 3.56/6.14、Binary Relevance 0.30/0.61、Classifier Chains 0.33/0.68、RAkELd 0.59/1.35、BHPI E=10/15/20 为 1.6/2.7/3.2 与 4.1/6.4/9.3。UKB memory GB/training min/inference ms：Logistic 3.74/5.82/<0.1、LightGBM 3.18/17.41/0.48、Binary Relevance 1.45/12.24/0.29、Classifier Chains 1.36/8.23/0.56、RAkELd 1.39/3.06/1.56、BHPI E=60 27.8/73.7/<0.1。
tables.evidence_relation: Section 4.2 O(N·E·(P+V)) complexity → runtime/memory/latency table → Figure 10 active-edge pruning；结论限定于给定 hardware/configuration。
design_strengths: grouped table 同时呈现 simulation scaling、UKB memory、training tax 和 inference latency。
硬件写入 caption，结构发现成本与 baseline 可直接并置。
design_weaknesses: 不同 workload、E、硬件不可直接横比；BHPI slash cell 省略配置细节。
没有 measurement repetitions、parallel scaling 或 variability。
tables.reusable_pattern: 把 asymptotic claim、small simulation scaling 和 deployment latency 放在同一 grouped table，并按 workload/hardware 报告 variability。

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 从 EHR 输入到 latent hypergraph、risk-factor effect 与 structured VI 建立接口；Tables 1–2 给 simulation prediction/structure headline，Table 3 做 repulsion toggle；Figure 2/Table 4–5 连接 UKB rare-disease stability、calibration 与 prevalence tests；Figures 3–4/Table 6 把 PIP、parsimony、masking 与 qualitative pathway 接上。Appendix Figures 5–11、Tables 7–10 展开 generative/effect recovery、λ/E robustness、calibration、dataset、runtime 与 ROC。
cross_object_system.caption_system: Figure 1–4、6、8、10 与 Tables 1、3、5–7、10 的 caption 含 setup/encoding 或 main finding；Figure 9 只有 title，Table 4/9 较短，Figure 11 caption 与实际六方法 legend 不完全一致。多数 caption 不定义 band、violin smoothing、PIP threshold selection 或 split aggregation。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Tables 1–4 使用单层 compact header；Tables 5–6 使用 prevalence/configuration 条件列；Table 7 以 N 分组重复 metrics；Table 8 对照 structural ECE；Table 9 按 cohort statistic group；Table 10 以 dataset→metric→N 三层 grouped header 组织 runtime。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 1/5 与 Eq. (1)–(2) 的 latent mechanism → Tables 1–2/Figure 2 prediction and structure → Tables 3/7、Figures 8–10 repulsion/capacity sensitivity → Table 8 calibration → Table 10 compute boundary；Figures 6–7 和 Table 6 是 structure-to-signal intermediate checks。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 正文 Figures 1–4、Tables 1–6 保留主线并指向 Appendix B.1/B.3、C、D；Appendix Figures 5–7 给 generative/recovery detail，Figures 8–10 给 λ/E mechanism，Tables 7–10 和 Figure 11 给 ablation/calibration/dataset/runtime/disease-level detail。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: caption/table 由 Nimbus Roman/Computer Modern PDF objects 稳定呈现；图内 quantitative graphics 多是 Arial/DejaVu Sans-like raster，Figure 1/4 conceptual labels 与 Figures 8–11 Matplotlib-like labels 在字号 token 上有轻微差异。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: Figure 2 的 method palette、Figure 8 的 N palette、Figure 9 的 metric/sample palette 与 Figure 3/6 PIP sequential palette 各自局部稳定；Figure 4/7 改用 pathway/effect context，故跨图必须结合 legend、位置和线型，不能假定同色同义。

most_reusable_patterns: Figure 1 的三段 workflow 加下排 constraint/regularizer 分解，让生成结构与 inference mechanism 同时可见。
Figure 2 的 prevalence-stratified violin distribution 用零线和全分布展示 rare-disease failure tail，而非只报总体均值。
Figure 3/6 的 PIP 或 true-inferred heatmap 加结构摘要，把 posterior uncertainty 接到 topology shape 和 sparsity。
Table 3/7 与 Figures 8–10 的 component toggle、λ/E sweep、active-edge count 链区分 predictive robustness 与 identifiability mechanism。
Table 10 的 grouped runtime table 把 asymptotic complexity、simulation scaling、memory、training tax 和 inference latency 放入同一决策面。
highest_value_objects: Figure 2 是 rare-disease stability 的分布级 headline。
Figures 3–4 是 latent pathway/parsimony 到 qualitative interpretation 的核心桥梁。
Table 5 是 prevalence-specific structured advantage 的最强量化对象。
Table 8 与 Table 10 分别限定 posterior calibration 与 compute/scalability claim；Figure 11 将 aggregate UKB performance 落到代表性病种 ROC。
failure_patterns: 公开仓库只有三张匹配 rendered assets，没有完整 plotting/table source；其余 Figure/Table 只能由 PDF 复核。
Figure 9、Figure 10、Table 6 和部分 Figure 11 caption 不能独立恢复全部条件；band、violin、split aggregation 与 selection rule 常缺失。
密集网络/热图缺少可交互节点索引，跨图颜色角色变化增加误读风险。
没有 structured VI、observation model 或 PIP threshold 的完整独立 component ablation，故机制解释仍受实验边界约束。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 论文以“workflow/plate → prediction and structure tables → rare-disease distributions and PIP/network mechanisms → repulsion/capacity/calibration/compute extensions”的双栏证据链，把 risk-factor-specific hypergraph interpretability 与预测、鲁棒性和实现边界串联起来，但完整数值与可编辑视觉源仍需依赖 PDF 和未公开的排版过程。
